# TourStep

Use a Tour to introduce a feature or onboard a user through a few key parts of the UI. Compose it from TourStep children, each pointing at an element via targetRef; the Tour advances through them with Next/Back and ends on Done. It is controlled: keep isActive in your own state and persist "has seen this tour" yourself (the component only reports dismissal via onDismiss). Built on the existing Popover/Layer anchoring and overlay tokens rather than a bespoke positioning engine.

**Import:** `import {TourStep} from '@astryxdesign/lab';`

## Best Practices

- **Do:** Keep tours short: a few high-value steps. Long tours get skipped.
- **Do:** Persist completion yourself (from onDismiss) so a user does not see the same tour on every visit.
- **Do:** Point each step at a stable, visible element; ensure the target is on-screen before its step becomes active.
- **Don't:** Gate essential, must-see information behind a tour step; users can dismiss it; put critical info inline.
- **Don't:** Use a tour as a substitute for clear UI; fix confusing interfaces rather than narrating them.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `targetRef` | `RefObject<HTMLElement>` | - | Ref to the element this step points at. The callout anchors to it like a Popover trigger; it must be a <button> or [role="button"] element (Popover's anchorRef contract). **(required)** |
| `heading` | `ReactNode` | - | Step heading. **(required)** |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | - | Step body content. |
| `placement` | `'above' \| 'below' \| 'start' \| 'end'` | `'below'` | Which side of the target the callout sits on. |
| `alignment` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'` | `'start'` | How the callout aligns along the placement side (e.g. with placement="below": start left-aligns under the target, center centers, end right-aligns). |

## Components

### TourStep

A single spotlight step. Highlights a target element with a ring drawn as a separate overlay (the target is never restyled) and renders a callout anchored to it (via the core Popover), with a heading, body, optional step progress, and back / next / close controls. Registers with the parent Tour on mount and renders its callout only while active.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `targetRef` | `RefObject<HTMLElement>` | - | Ref to the element this step points at. The callout anchors to it like a Popover trigger; it must be a <button> or [role="button"] element (Popover's anchorRef contract). **(required)** |
| `heading` | `ReactNode` | - | Step heading. **(required)** |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | - | Step body content. |
| `placement` | `'above' \| 'below' \| 'start' \| 'end'` | `'below'` | Which side of the target the callout sits on. |
| `alignment` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'` | `'start'` | How the callout aligns along the placement side (e.g. with placement="below": start left-aligns under the target, center centers, end right-aligns). |
